Focal class suppression is already confirmed as a separate issue and remains unresolved.

Recover original current frames and observed-head receipts from target_packet_real_particle_pilot; do not select by new outcomes or replace cases. fixed.parameters: Keep the all-zero point and the one200-iteration returned candidate. The unsuccessful optimizer status remains. Do not refit, rescale, clip, pick checkpoints, change priors or adjust any physical rule.
fixed.target_law: Same focal-prefix law, complete geometry-selected J, zero physical kernel/model, frozen nuisance and goal priors, receiving-goal rules, responsive full background and LC order. Only recorded J-node proposal probabilities change. Focal LC remains analytically integrated; do not insert its probability into the prefix proposal ratio a second time.
fixed.proposals: q0 is the original ancestral zero-parameter proposal; qf is the same ancestral program with J Bernoulli probabilities sigmoid(theta_f[b] dot cached_current_phi) and prefocal LC conditional softmax from theta_f. Keep masks and their prefix dependencies unchanged. Do not make kernel.model use theta_f: that would change physical nominal motion and the target family.
fixed.mixture: For each case generate128 fresh q0 and128 fresh qf particles, interleaved component0/componentf. Use the marginal qmix=0.5*q0+0.5*qf denominator for every particle, not its component denominator. Any first128 prefix thus has64 of each component. No reuse of fitted-training particle draws as fresh confirmation.
fixed.seeds: For original case_index i0..14, component0 seed20261113+100000*i, componentf seed20261114+100000*i. Retain the old nuisance seed76116999+seed*100000+time_sec and identical registered current bindings.
fixed.importance_weights: The existing per-prefix log ratio r_eta=log(p_eta/q0) is reconstructed from recorded factors. With frozen anchorf, subtract offset=logaddexp(log0.5,log0.5+r_f) from r_eta at both target points. Target scores and focal class-table derivatives stay unchanged; do not differentiate the frozen proposal anchor. Raw prefix weights for eta0/f are at most2, but this does not guarantee finite-sample ESS, rare-label posterior ESS or prediction accuracy.

implementation_gate: Implement the qf Bernoulli and prefocal categorical draws explicitly, with the same canonical current-goal feature tables and physical outcomes as the frozen sampler. The existing hardcoded0.5/uniform sampler cannot be relabeled asqf. Keep numeric-only preparation storage and exact proposal/component metadata.

Before real cases, use pure cached arithmetic tests for the fixed-mixture offset, target gradients with anchor held fixed, component interleaving/prefix composition, class normalization, zeros and infinities. Validate zero-anchor reduction and the raw endpoint weight bound2 without probability floors.

Within a separate1024 synthetic full-forward ceiling, compare old/new q0 streams at identical seeds on small existing fixtures, including a two-actor prefocal-LC case. Check qf path probabilities against the exact recorded factor product and tiny exact conditional laws at the two fixed targets. Freeze fixture names and symbolic cost before responses; do not rerun the full earlier panels or invoke an optimizer.
real_pilot: Re-register unchanged required participants and internal bindings from the existing15-case preflight before responses. One new256-particle mixture pool per case serves both points and first128/all256 readouts. Do not build real exact references or alter the oldq0 pools.

Report corrected zero/fitted native-head NLL, normalization, global/survivor/posterior ESS, raw and normalized weight maxima, component counts, and the same four focal/latent class combinations for LC references. Compare with the savedq0 first256/full1024 diagnostics, preserving all support failures and undefined differences.

A positive-branch/domain/budget/technical failure stops new-case dispatch while in-flight cases finish, with all partial consumed counts retained. Never reject a branch and redraw or renormalize a truncated domain. Sampling support misses remain visible; do not choose another seed or increaseN.

Judge numerical sensitivity at the frozen candidate only. If the corrected estimate changes materially, revisit the old cached interpretation before further fitting. If it agrees, retain the model-calibration evidence and focal suppression issue. Do not treat either outcome as source-city attribution, convergence, independent prediction or control benefit. Stop after this15-case pilot.
